text: Choanoflagellates, with their single flagellum surrounded by a collar of microvilli, are described as the closest known single-celled relatives of the animals.
explanation: True. Choanoflagellates are the closest unicellular relatives of animals; their collar-and-flagellum feeding apparatus mirrors the choanocytes (collar cells) of sponges, and their genomes carry homologs of animal cell-signaling and synaptic proteins, marking the bridge from the protist world to the animal world.
